tools.name: cancel_pipeline_run
tools.description: Stop a pending or running pipeline run. Credits for work that did not happen are returned; work already finished may still be charged. A run that has already finished cannot be cancelled.

tools.name: estimate_pipeline_cost
tools.description: Estimate the credits a pipeline run would cost before running it, with the same input you would pass to run_pipeline. tools.name: get_pipeline_run_status
tools.description: Check the status of a pipeline run. Returns status (pending/running/completed/failed), output data, error messages, timestamps, and generated asset URLs.

tools.name: get_pipeline_schema
tools.description: Get the input schema for a specific pipeline. Returns the JSON Schema describing required and optional input fields. Use this before running a pipeline to understand what inputs are needed.

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: List all available AI video/image pipelines. Returns name, slug, description, category, credit cost, and required providers for each active pipeline.

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: Run an AI pipeline by slug with the given input. Use list_pipelines to discover available pipelines, get_pipeline_schema to see required inputs and estimate_pipeline_cost to check the price. tools.name: wait_for_pipeline_run
tools.description: Wait until a pipeline run finishes, then return its final status, output and generated assets. Each call waits at most timeout_seconds; if the run is still going, the result says so and you can call it again. Prefer this to repeated get_pipeline_run_status calls.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pipeline_run_status, request_upload · Private data: request_upload · Public sink: request_upload · Destructive: cancel_pipeline_run, estimate_pipeline_cost, get_pipeline_run_status, run_pipeline, wait_for_pipeline_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pipeline_run_status, request_upload · Private data: request_upload · Public sink: request_upload · Destructive: cancel_pipeline_run, estimate_pipeline_cost, get_pipeline_run_status, run_pipeline, wait_for_pipeline_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "run_pipeline" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
